messages:
maria: Hey - billing dashboard just alerted: a small set of users got charged twice for streaming requests that hit a truncation + retry path. Ticket #BILL-1221. Seen any of you?
ajay: ugh. Any pattern on model/version or region?
maria: all yolo: redwood-small-v1, us-west-2, looks correlated with canary routing (10% route) and mid-request model downgrade.
sam: is this the reconnect -> fallback -> toolcall flow we discussed last month?
maria: sounds like it. The stream truncated, client retried, we routed to fallback variant which executed a toolcall. Both the original and retry ended up being provisional-billed.
emily: do we have session ids / idempotency tokens for toolcalls in that flow?
maria: not consistently. Router attaches X-Session-Id but toolcall idempotency currently relies on client-supplied id only. If the client retries without id, toolcall gets re-executed.
ajay: Hmm. Could be double-charge because provisional ledger got two commits: one from original path, one from fallback. Need to check ledger tombstone/dedupe window.
sam: I dug logs for a repro trace:
```
router: session=ssn_abc123 routed->canary
runtime: stream truncated at seq=42
client: reconnect
router: fallback route->stable
toolrunner: toolcall executed id=none
ledger: provisional credit +42tokens session=ssn_abc123
```
Then retry path wrote another provisional.
emily: So two provisionals for same logical request. The dedupe key should be (session, request-prefix) but since fallback re-routed the prefix ownership changed, we lost dedupe.
nate: Could we add a short-lived global dedupe key: hash(session_id + canonical-request-hash) with ttl=30s? That would catch quick retries across routes.
ajay: That helps, but we also need console clarity: users see provisional credits then final adjustments later — this case shows no reconciliation since both were finalized.
emily: Another angle: mark the stream final chunk explicitly so toolcall is suppressed until you see final=true. Add an internal header `X-Stream-Final: true` on end-of-stream. If truncated, retries can set it accordingly.
maria: But some clients stream indefinitely and call toolcall mid-stream, so final flag not always present.
sam: Right — toolcalls can occur mid-stream. For mid-stream toolcalls we need per-toolcall idempotency at the runtime level. We could require the runtime to synthesize an id based on (session_id, toolcall-offset, tool-name) and pass it to toolrunner. That id would survive routing.
ajay: runtime-synth id is nice but requires consistent offset detection across resume points. With prefix caching and chunked resume, offsets change.
emily: We can use prefix hash: compute sha256(prefix-bytes) at runtime and use that as toolcall id. That remains stable across retries if the content is the same.
nate: cheap and deterministic. Need to ensure prefixes aren't huge; we can cap to first N tokens.
maria: Agreed. OK quick mitigation: 1) add synthetic toolcall id in router when possible; 2) add TTL dedupe at ledger level; 3) emit a telemetry tag to identify affected customers so we can reconcile credits.
sam: Also add a dashboard alert: count of "toolcall double-provisionals" per model/route. We missed this signal.
ajay: I'll open an infra PR for ledger dedupe + TTL. Emily can you prototype synthetic id?
emily: on it. I'll drop a patch to runtime to compute prefix-sha and set header `X-Toolcall-Id`.
maria: ops-bot: created ticket BILL-1221, assigned to eng-platform, links: https://internal/p/BILL-1221
ops-bot: <@maria> Ticket BILL-1221 created and assigned to eng-platform.
maria: Thanks all — we'll correlate with customer reports and roll a canary fix next week. If anyone wants to pair on repro, ping me.
